headline: India considers Rs 80,000 crore expansion for underwater naval fleet
hook: Massive naval buildup to test domestic shipyards
summary: The Indian government is evaluating a massive Rs 80,000 crore proposal to acquire six new conventional submarines and three additional Scorpene-class submarines. This major defense acquisition aims to boost the Indian Navy's underwater combat capabilities amid regional security challenges. State-owned and private domestic defense shipyards are expected to play a central role in the manufacturing process. Indian retail investors with exposure to defense sector stocks should monitor tender flows and shipyard order books.
whats_next: Cabinet Committee on Security formal approval
why_it_matters: Defense shipyards eye multi-year order inflows.

headline: Mazagon Dock clarifies news report on Thoothukudi Shipyard project
hook: Unverified reports on Thoothukudi Shipyard project
summary: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders has responded to a news article published on the Hindu BusinessLine website regarding the Thoothukudi Shipyard project. The company issued a clarification to the stock exchanges under Regulation 30(11) of SEBI LODR regulations. Such clarifications help retail investors separate official corporate strategy from unverified media speculation.
whats_next: Official company announcements on the Thoothukudi project
why_it_matters: Media rumors clarified, keeping defence stock valuations grounded
